learnings: API reliability is critical for audit completion - models with HTTP 400 errors cannot provide verdicts even when the package is safe
Parse errors in model responses should trigger automatic retry with clearer output format instructions
When multiple models have technical failures but the one that succeeds finds no issues, and the successful reviews align with each other, confidence in the safe verdict is high
Standard Wine packaging patterns (wineboot, MSI installation, prefix initialization) should be recognized as benign by all models to reduce false positive risk
